info.name: Food Ordering App
info.description:
Postman collection for the Albaik KSA food ordering app. It is split into two folders:

1. **API (Customer Flow)** - JSON endpoints used by the mobile/web customer app: list branches → create a cart → browse a branch menu → add/update/remove cart items → checkout → receive an order confirmation.

2. **Admin** - HTML form endpoints used by staff to manage branches, menu items, branch menu items, and view orders.
